detail.body:
**Version**
`hyper v0.14.20`, `h2 v0.3.14`, `tokio v1.21.2`

**Platform**
`Linux seekr-xps15-zorin 5.13.0-35-generic #40~20.04.1-Ubuntu SMP Mon Mar 7 09:18:32 UTC 2022 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux`

**Description**
Passing in `Some(Duration::ZERO)` to [`hyper::client::Builder::pool_idle_timeout()`](https://docs.rs/hyper/0.14.20/hyper/client/struct.Builder.html#method.pool_idle_timeout) can lead to a panic. The panic happens in the [`tokio::time::interval()`](https://docs.rs/tokio/1.21.2/tokio/time/fn.interval.html) function, which disallows specifying a zero duration.

I have switched my code to use `builder.pool_max_idle_per_host(0)` instead, which works properly.
